title: Login
goal: Authenticate a registered user and establish an authorized session.
preconditions: Account exists and is active; login page is accessible.
main_flow:
1. Open login page.
2. Enter email and password.
3. Submit credentials.
4. System validates identity.
5. System creates authenticated session.
6. System resolves role.
7. Redirect to authorized landing page.
alternative_flows:
Invalid credentials → reject and show error.
Inactive account → deny login.
Missing fields → validation message.
postconditions: Authenticated session exists and user can access permitted functions.

title: Browse Available Courses
goal: Find open course sections relevant to the student's program.
preconditions: Student is authenticated; student has an academic program.
main_flow:
1. Open course catalogue.
2. Retrieve courses and sections.
3. Filter eligible program.
4. Filter open sections.
5. Display results.
6. Student selects a section for details.
alternative_flows:
No matching sections → empty state.
Section becomes unavailable → refresh and show current status.
postconditions: Student can see eligible open offerings.

title: Register for a Class
goal: Create a valid registration for an available section.
main_flow:
1. Submit registration.
2. Validate section status.
3. Validate capacity.
4. Validate duplicate registration.
5. Validate program eligibility.
6. Validate schedule conflict.
7. Create registration.
8. Increment enrollment count.
9. Create confirmation notification.
10. Commit transaction.
11. Redirect to registered classes.
alternative_flows:
Missing section → 404.
Closed/full/duplicate/ineligible/conflict → reject and do not persist partial changes.
postconditions: Confirmed registration exists; enrollment count and notification are consistent.

title: View and Cancel Registered Classes
goal: Review own registrations and cancel an eligible registration.
preconditions: Student authenticated; registrations exist or may be empty.
main_flow:
1. Open My Courses.
2. System loads own registrations.
3. Display course/section/status.
4. Student chooses cancellation.
5. System validates ownership/state.
6. Update registration state.
7. Adjust enrollment count if applicable.
8. Persist changes.
alternative_flows:
No registrations → empty state.
Already cancelled → reject duplicate action.
Unauthorized registration id → deny.
postconditions: Own registration list is current and cancellation is consistent.
trigger: Student opens My Courses or selects cancel.

title: Manage Course Sections
goal: Create, edit and cancel course sections.
main_flow:
1. Open admin class management.
2. Create or select a section.
3. Enter/edit course, lecturer, schedule, room, capacity, fee and status.
4. Validate fields.
5. Save changes.
6. For cancellation, update status and trigger affected-student notifications.
alternative_flows:
Invalid data → reject save.
Unauthorized role → 403/deny.
Cancellation with registrations → notify affected students.
postconditions: Section data is persisted and its status controls registration availability.

title: View Notifications
goal: View notifications generated for the authenticated user.
main_flow:
1. Open notifications.
2. Retrieve notifications by recipient.
3. Sort/display recent notifications.
4. Show notification status.
alternative_flows:
No notifications → empty state.
Data retrieval failure → user-facing error.
postconditions: Only the authenticated user's notifications are displayed.

title: Register Student Account
preconditions: Registration is enabled; required fields are available.
main_flow:
1. Open registration page.
2. Enter identity/account data.
3. Validate required fields and unique identifiers.
4. Create account.
5. Confirm successful registration.
alternative_flows:
Duplicate email/student code → reject.
Invalid/missing data → validation error.
postconditions: New student account exists and can be used for login.

title: Logout
main_flow:
1. User selects Logout.
2. System terminates session.
3. Redirect to login.
alternative_flows: Already expired session → redirect to login.

title: View Dashboard and Profile
goal: View student-specific summary and profile information.
main_flow:
1. Open dashboard/profile.
2. Load authenticated student's data.
3. Display registration summary and profile.
alternative_flows:
Missing optional data → display safe defaults.
Attempt to access another user's data → deny.

title: Validate Registration Rules
goal: Apply all registration business rules before commit.
main_flow:
1. Resolve section.
2. Check status.
3. Check capacity.
4. Check duplicate.
5. Check program eligibility.
6. Compare schedules.
7. Return validation result to registration transaction.
alternative_flows:
Any rule failure → reject without partial commit.
Adjacent time boundaries → accepted as non-overlap.
postconditions: Validation decision is deterministic and transaction-safe.

title: View Assigned Teaching Sections
goal: View teaching sections assigned to the logged-in lecturer.
main_flow:
1. Open teaching schedule.
2. Query sections assigned to current lecturer.
3. Display schedule/class information.
alternative_flows:
No assigned sections → empty state.
Request for another lecturer's data → deny/filter out.

title: View Administration Statistics
main_flow:
1. Open statistics.
2. Query current counts.
3. Aggregate results.
4. Display statistics.
alternative_flows:
Unauthorized role → 403.
No data → zero/empty counts.
postconditions: Statistics reflect current persisted data and are visible only to administrators.

title: Create Registration Confirmation
goal: Create a confirmation notification after a successful registration.
preconditions: Registration transaction has passed all validations and is committed/ready to commit.
main_flow:
1. Receive successful registration event.
2. Resolve student recipient.
3. Build notification content.
4. Persist notification.
5. Make notification available to the student.
alternative_flows: Notification persistence failure → transaction handling must prevent inconsistent success state.
postconditions: Student receives an in-system confirmation notification linked to the registration event.
